args.subject: Private Dining Table Request for 12 – Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a private dining table for 12 guests at your restaurant on Friday, May 24, 2024.

We would ideally like to book the early evening seating, around 7:00 PM, though we would be happy to be flexible with the exact time depending on availability. Please let us know what times you have open for a party of 12, along with any information about your private dining menu, pricing, and deposit or reservation requirements.

If you need any details in advance, such as dietary preferences or a set menu, please let me know and I will follow up promptly.

Thank you for your time, and we look forward to hosting our guests at New Asiaway.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923

final_text:
